bio.text: Ky Holland, who is listed as not affiliated with a party, has represented District 9 in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2025.
His legislative biography says Holland grew up in Anchorage and has four decades of experience as an engineer, business manager, university educator and consultant.

It lists a B.S. in mechanical engineering from Oregon State University (1985) and an MBA from the University of Phoenix (2000), and positions including Technology Commercialization Officer at the University of Alaska Fairbanks and cofounder of Alyeska Venture Management.
